block.prompt:
Now write your own blog post for the partner class (about 70 to 90 words). Include ALL of these:
1. a short greeting,
2. something you did recently and how you felt (past tense),
3. a plan for the future ("Next ... I am going to ..." / "I will ..."),
4. one book, film or series you recommend,
5. a question to the partner class at the end.
Plan your text first, then write.
block.answer_key: Model answer (about 80 words): Hi everyone! My name is Sara and I am thirteen. Last weekend, I went to a concert with my best friend. The music was amazing and I felt really excited! Next month, I am going to start a dance course, and I hope I will make new friends there. At the moment I am watching a series called "Young Detectives" — it is exciting and funny, so I recommend it. What do you like doing at the weekend? Write back soon!
block.acceptable_reasoning: Der Inhalt ist frei; alle fünf Elemente müssen vorkommen und der Text soll zusammenhängen (Begrüßung, Erlebnis, Plan, Empfehlung, Frage).

levels: A clear question to the reader

watch_outs: Alle fünf Bausteine abhaken — am häufigsten fehlen die Abschlussfrage und die Empfehlung.
Zusammenhang zählt: Verbindungswörter (and, but, because, so) und Zeitmarker (Last weekend, Next month) statt loser Einzelsätze.
Wortzahl (70–90) ernst nehmen: zu kurze Texte lassen meist ein Element aus; auf die Mischung von Vergangenheit UND Zukunft achten.
